item.title: Mistral Large 3: deprecated
item.description: 2026-10-31: Official model card marks this model deprecated and recommends Large 4 for new integrations. Its current direct pricing row was removed; the previous official quote is historical. This does not establish an API shutdown or withdrawal of independently hosted weights/routes. Source: https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-3-25-12

item.title: Mistral Large 3: deprecation
